verdict.rationale: stagewise is an agentic IDE where you chat with a coding agent. It documents debugging directly: the agent takes screenshots, inspects what users see, and has full access to the browser tab's console and debugger. You can also attach tabs and files as context to a natural-language request. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of debugging and troubleshooting workflows (e.g., error tracing, breakpoints driven from chat), and independent or hands-on corroboration of debugging quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can debug issues and troubleshoot using natural-language queries

citations.quote: Debug visually — The agent takes screenshots and inspects what users see
Work with a coding agent that has full access to your tab's console and debugger
@mention tabs — Attach a browser tab so the agent sees what you're looking at
Type / in the chat to see available commands from your skills and plugins.
